name: 哥布林
subject:
One original full-body GOBLIN (哥布林), lean hunched small humanoid with olive-green skin, long pointed ears, hooked nose, beady amber eyes, complete arms and two complete legs/feet. Worn brown leather vest, dusty ochre trousers, a small rust-red neck scarf and belt, dull iron short cleaver in right hand, empty left hand; no shield. Head/body proportions grounded, not a giant chibi head. Weathered green/brown with one restrained rust-red accent. Match the sprite scale/detail of the project's articulated skeleton warriors.
IDLE: breathing and small shoulder/ear motion, cleaver low. MOVE: a six-pose crouched walk with clearly alternating bent knees/feet and counter-swinging weapon. ATTACK: low ready, pull cleaver back, raise it, sharp chopping slash toward LEFT, follow-through, recover. DIE: recoil, knees buckle, pitch sideways, hit ground, cleaver and full body settle, final complete goblin corpse; no decapitation or graphic gore.

name: 骷髏兵
subject:
One original full-body DESERT SKELETON SOLDIER (骷髏兵), match the recently created skeleton warriors' weathered ivory/ochre skull and bones, hollow dark eye sockets, thin neck, ribcage, spine, pelvis, TWO complete articulated legs and TWO feet. A distinct desert infantry variation: small battered open-face bronze skullcap, short tattered muted turquoise/verdigris waist cloth and shoulder scrap, brown leather belt, a rusty curved short scimitar in right hand and a small plain weathered bronze buckler in the left. Ivory bones, brown leather, dull bronze and restrained faded turquoise accent. Sparse equipment keeps most bones visible. Not a recolor of the earlier red shield or green axe soldiers; new skullcap/cloth/scimitar silhouette. All equipment stays attached in alive poses.
IDLE: subtle skull/shoulder breathing, scimitar down, buckler near ribs. MOVE: six-pose complete leg/joint walking cycle, knees and ankles alternate, weapon counter-swing. ATTACK: ready, withdraw sword, shoulder rotates, curved scimitar slashes decisively LEFT, follow through, recover; buckler on opposite arm. DIE: recoil, knees buckle, fall sideways, bones and scimitar land, skeleton settles into a low corpse, final full skeletal remains with helmet/buckler/weapon near same foot baseline, not six skull-only frames.

name: 樹妖
subject:
One original TREE SPIRIT / TREANT (樹妖), a full-body animated gnarled tree monster. Heavy weathered umber-grey trunk torso, a clear stern face formed from bark knots with two small amber eye slits, crooked branch crown, TWO thick branching arms and hands, TWO separated articulated root legs/feet. Sparse desaturated moss-green leaves and a little pale lichen are modest color accents; mostly readable dry bark and root anatomy. No human armor, no staff, not a static tree stump, not a branch-only half body, no cute face. Match the grounded detailed low-res skeleton style. All branch tips and roots fully inside each cell.
IDLE: subtle torso/branch breathing and tiny leaf motion, root feet grounded. MOVE: six heavy walking poses with clearly alternating root knees/feet, trunk and arms counter-swing, do not slide a static tree. ATTACK: ready, trunk twists backward, raises one thick branch arm, heavy downward branch-claw swipe/slam toward LEFT, follow-through, recover; other root arm balances. DIE: recoil, root knees buckle, trunk lists, falls onto side, branches/roots settle, a low complete wooden corpse remains. No giant explosion, no extra trees or detached decorative foliage outside the cell.

name: 蜥蜴戰士
subject:
One original LIZARD WARRIOR (蜥蜴戰士), a full-body lean reptilian humanoid with a long angular lizard snout, small ochre eyes, teal/sage-green scales with pale warm belly, a short low dorsal crest, two clawed arms, TWO digitigrade articulated legs and two clawed feet, and a COMPLETE long tapering tail curling inward behind it so it fits its cell. Weathered bronze shoulder scale and wrist bands, sparse brown leather straps and a muted rust-red waist cloth. Carries ONE compact bronze-tipped SHORT SPEAR in both hands, NO shield. The spear shaft and tip must fit inside the cell in every thrust. Reptilian, not a human in a lizard mask, not a dragon with wings, no modern weapons. Limited teal/bronze/rust accent colors with dark contours.
IDLE: guarded slight breathing, short spear diagonal across torso, complete feet and tail. MOVE: six crouched stalking/walking poses with alternating knee/hock/feet articulation, tail counterbalances, spear held steadily. ATTACK: ready, pull spear toward rear, brace legs, thrust spear strongly LEFT, follow-through, pull back to guard; both hands visibly hold shaft throughout. DIE: recoil, knees collapse, tips sideways, body and spear hit ground, tail curls and settles, final complete reptile corpse with spear. No tail being cut off and no graphic gore.

name: 半獸人
subject:
One original ORC / HALF-BEAST BRUTE (半獸人), a full-body broad heavy muscular humanoid, much broader shoulders and more massive anatomy than the previously drawn small goblin. Rough grey-olive skin, short low brow and broad flattened nose, two small visible upward lower tusks, tiny amber eyes, short dark coarse hair, complete TWO arms/hands and TWO strong legs/feet. Battered dark iron shoulder plate and forearm bracer, brown leather belts and boots, short dusty russet-red waist wrap with a little dull bone ornament. Holds a broad chipped heavy IRON CHOPPER / short cleaver in its right hand, empty left fist. Not a goblin, pig animal, human bandit, giant boss, or futuristic soldier. Grounded ordinary enemy scale, restrained grey-olive/iron/leather/russet colors, same dark outlined pixel-art detail as our skeletons. All body parts and blade stay inside cell margins.
IDLE: heavy chest/shoulder breathing, chopper low and left fist clenched. MOVE: six weighty strides with alternating thighs/knees/feet and shoulder/weapon counter-swing; articulate, do not translate a static body. ATTACK: ready, pull blade back, lift blade and shoulder, heavy diagonal chopping strike toward LEFT, broad follow-through, recover. DIE: recoil, knees buckle, stumble sideways, fall to side, chopper/full body settle, final complete orc corpse, no graphic gore.
